title: Imports
description: Bring your records and documents into one connected workspace.
newDescription: Upload a file, check the column mapping, then review every row before importing.
emptyTitle: Your first import starts with a spreadsheet.
emptyDescription: Import customers, projects and other records from a spreadsheet. Add document archives and connect them to those records.
entityOrderWarning: Import customers, projects and other referenced records first. Then connect documents to them using a shared identifier.
readOnly: You can review imports. Ask an organization member with write access to create or change one.
rowCount: {count, plural, =0 {No rows yet} one {# row} other {# rows}}
whatToImport: What would you like to import?
chooseFile: Choose a file or drop it here
spreadsheetHint: CSV, TSV or XLSX · up to 100 MB and 50,000 rows.
archiveHint: ZIP with documents and an optional manifest.csv or manifest.xlsx at its root. CSV, TSV and XLSX can also match existing documents. Up to 100 MB.
xlsError: This is an older Excel file. Open it in Excel, save as .xlsx, and choose the new file.
fileError: Choose a supported, non-empty file under 100 MB. ZIP archives are for document imports.
oneFile: Choose one file per import. Put multiple documents in a ZIP archive.
uploadError: The file could not be uploaded. Check your connection and try again.
nothingWritten: You will review the results before any records change.
mappingIncomplete: Choose a name column and at least one identifier for entities. Check that every connection has a type, matching field and source column.
mappingColumnsChanged: This mapping references columns missing from this file. Select the columns again before validating.
noEntityTypes: Create an entity type in Entities before importing records.
identifierHelp: Map at least one unique identifier. Matching records will be updated, so a repeat import does not create duplicates.
noIdentifiers: This entity type has no identifier field. Add one in entity type settings before importing.
optionalFields: Leave columns unmapped to keep them out of this import. Required fields are marked with an asterisk. Invalid values in optional fields are omitted by the importer.
validationHelp: Validation checks every row without changing your records.
requestError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
retryHint: Your saved import is available here. Check the settings and try the action again.
inspectHelp: Read the column names and sample values, detect the file encoding, and count the rows. Large files may take a little longer.
draftRecovery: If the upload was interrupted, start a new import with the original file.
previewHelp: These are the first rows from your file. Check accented characters and column boundaries before mapping.
reparseHelp: Reanalyzing rebuilds the preview and requires validation again. Unsaved mapping changes will be discarded.
emptyFile: This file has no data rows. Start a new import with a file containing records.
reviewHelp: Every row has been checked. Nothing has been imported yet. Review the results below and correct the mapping if needed.
validationMissing: This import has no saved review summary. Edit the mapping and validate again to continue.
saveMapping: Save this mapping for next time
confirmWithErrors: I reviewed the results. Import valid rows and leave rows with errors or conflicts unchanged.
confirmReview: I reviewed the mapping and row results and am ready to import.
backgroundHelp: You can leave this page after starting. The import continues in the background; return here for results.
pollError: Updates are temporarily unavailable. Reconnecting automatically; your import may still be running.
ocrHelp: Files are processed separately after import. Text recognition and document connections may appear later; the import does not wait for OCR.
ocrFailures: Some documents could not be processed. Check the documents list for details.
cancelHelp: Stop processing remaining rows? Records already imported will remain. Rows currently processing may still finish.
loadErrorHelp: Check your connection and try again. Existing imports continue in the background.

kindDescription.entities: Create or update customers, projects and other entities from a spreadsheet.
kindDescription.documents: Upload document files and connect them to existing records.
kindDescription.metadata_only: Add fields and connections to documents already in your workspace.

duplicate.skip: Skip the duplicate; still apply its connections and fields
duplicate.fail: Flag the row as an error
duplicate.create_anyway: Request a new document even if a match exists

missing.fail_row: Flag the row as an error

plan.skip_duplicate: Skip duplicate; apply links and fields

busy.analyzing: Reading file and preparing the preview…
busy.validating: Checking every row. Large files may take a little longer…

errors.IDENTIFIER_CONFLICT: More than one record matches this identifier.
errors.FILE_MISSING_IN_ARCHIVE: The file is missing from the ZIP archive.
errors.PAPERLESS_ERROR: The document service could not process this row.
errors.UNKNOWN: This row could not be processed.
